source_review.notes: Checked all 13 structured references against current official Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Parquet, and Apache Hudi specifications/documentation. Verified sort orders and identities, file statistics, pruning, clustering/Z-order procedures, Bloom behavior and encryption, page/column indexes, dictionary chunks, metadata indexes, and linear/Z/Hilbert clustering claims in their stated scopes; all final URLs returned HTTP 200.

evidence: Checked definitions for files, predicates, conservative MayMatch, bounds, selected files, scan ratios, interval overlap, Bloom probability, weighted layout score, and rewrite benefit.
Checked every displayed implication, disjointness test, probability approximation, fraction, overlap, equality, and cost expression for defined symbols and balanced syntax.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation consistently separates logical row predicates from conservative metadata evidence, physical locality, empirical performance, and rewrite equivalence.

evidence: Executed clustered-range-skipping and matched scattered/clustered bounds, five versus two candidates, reduction three, results (4,5), and equality.
Recomputed every bound intersection for query [4,5]: all scattered intervals overlap, while only [3,4] and [5,6] overlap after sorting.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The executable demonstrates the intended reduction without claiming that bounds prove row presence or that one synthetic distribution predicts production benefit.

evidence: Verified that existence of a matching row implies MayMatch, the direction required to forbid pruning false negatives.
Verified the range skip disjunction from enclosing bounds and the distinction between file selectivity, byte ratio, interval overlap, and logical equality.
Checked the Bloom false-positive approximation and confirmed the text scopes actual hashing/layout to the format specification.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Clustering changes bound distributions and performance, not the conservative proof rule or logical result.

evidence: Reviewed missing/truncated/contradictory bounds, null/all-null, NaN/infinities/signed zero, negative values, decimals, timestamps, Unicode/binary order, schema rename/promotion, and encrypted-unavailable metadata.

Reviewed Bloom false positives/hash mismatches, dictionary fallback, ordered/unordered pages, disjunction/negation, multidimensional dilution, skew, hot writes, partial progress, stale indexes, old layouts, sensitive membership, and unsupported readers.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Adversarial analysis covers silent false-negative corruption, performance regressions, metadata leakage, incompatibility, and layout drift.

evidence: Traced conservative pruning and residual evaluation through partition, manifest/index, file, row-group, page, dictionary, and Bloom layers.

Confirmed row/key/delete/schema/spec preservation, actual order IDs, isolated rewrite, conflicts, historical retention, drift, economics, fleet gates, and metadata protection across exposition, examples, and answers.
invariant_checking.notes: No overlap, positive Bloom result, declared sort, successful rewrite, or one benchmark is treated as proof of row truth or durable benefit.

evidence: Reviewed the seven-step range-skipping proof from enclosing bounds through the two disjoint cases and residual evaluation.
Confirmed that clustering only changes bound tightness and therefore cannot alter the proof's truth conditions.
proof_review.notes: The proof is valid under its explicitly stated comparable, non-null, sound-bound premises.

evidence: The range-skipping argument is explicitly labeled a proof sketch.
The following paragraph excludes null/NaN predicates, unsound/incomparable bounds, correlations, and unsupported expressions.
Performance formulas and Bloom probability are labeled as metrics/models or approximations.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No product feature, sample layout, empirical improvement, or approximate membership result is mislabeled as universal proof.

evidence: Current format/engine behavior is attributed to dated primary specifications/documentation and scoped to named implementations.
The executable disclaims implementation of table/file formats, nulls, NaNs, deletes, Bloom filters, page indexes, and distributed rewrite.
Linear, Z-order, and Hilbert behavior is described as strategy-dependent locality rather than guaranteed universal query improvement.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Specification semantics, teaching abstraction, workload evidence, and security/economic policy remain distinct.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed the chapter end to end. It develops skipping as conservative proof, explains the full pruning hierarchy, connects linear and multidimensional locality to statistics, and integrates safe rewrite, workload selection, drift, compatibility, and metadata security without conflating performance with correctness.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed retrieval and layout contracts, workload cohorts, sort/space-filling choices, statistics/Bloom/page capabilities, rewrite mechanics, comparison controls, drift triggers, economics, fleet fixtures, fallback behavior, encryption, metrics, and ownership for production usability.

pedagogical_review.notes: Reviewed progression from one-page model through hierarchy, formal soundness, executable contrast, trade-offs, 24 misconceptions, ten examples, cross-program connections, and five distinct exercises with worked answers. Connections accurately extend DE-034/063–067 into DE-069–073.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
